definitions.explanation: Fine powdery substance produced by flowers for plant reproduction. Pollen is a major cause of allergies, especially in spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{花粉|かふん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: A lot of pollen flies around in spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蜂|はち}→蜂：02242_hachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{花粉|かふん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めて→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{花粉|かふん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飛散量|ひさんりょう}→飛散量：28487_hisanryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。

examples.english: Cedar pollen flies from February through April, so going out during that period is tough.

notes:
{花粉|かふん} refers to pollen.

Common expressions:
- {花粉|かふん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (pollen flies/disperses)
- {花粉|かふん}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (pollen forecast)
- {花粉|かふん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飛散量|ひさんりょう}→飛散量：28487_hisanryou⟧ (amount of pollen dispersal)
- {花粉|かふん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{媒介|ばいかい}→媒介：15990_baikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to carry pollen)

Related terms:
- ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧ (hay fever, pollen allergy)
- ⟦{杉|すぎ}→杉：03889_sugi⟧{花粉|かふん} (cedar pollen - the main allergen in Japan)
- {花粉|かふん}⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧ (pollen mask)

Note:
{花粉|かふん} is heavily associated with allergies in Japan. Weather forecasts regularly include pollen counts ({花粉|かふん}⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧) during spring, and many Japanese wear masks during pollen season.
